title: P2: build_dio reads multiple fields without lock - potential thread safety issue
description:
In python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py, the build_dio method (lines 364-375) reads multiple mutable state fields (rpl_instance_id, version, rank, dodag_id, grounded, gateway_centric) without acquiring self._lock. If another thread modifies DODAG state between field reads (e.g., via _adopt_version or select_parent), the returned DIO may contain internally inconsistent values.

Example race:
1. Thread A reads self.version = 1
2. Thread B calls _adopt_version, sets self.version = 2, clears parents, sets self.rank = INFINITE_RANK
3. Thread A reads self.rank = INFINITE_RANK
4. Thread A returns DIO with version=1, rank=INFINITE_RANK (inconsistent)

While Python GIL ensures individual attribute reads are atomic, it does not ensure consistency across multiple reads.

Fix: Wrap the entire DIO construction in with self._lock.

File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py
Line: 364-375
Priority: P2
Category: thread-safety, correctness
